name: Introduction and overview — Spruance-class Destroyer — ship record
title: Introduction and overview — Spruance-class Destroyer
description: Introduction and overview of the Spruance-class Destroyer: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Spruance class was the U.S. Navy's first gas-turbine destroyer: 31 built from 1975, optimized for anti-submarine warfare with quiet hulls and towed arrays. The large hull later parented the Ticonderoga cruisers. Spruances served through the Cold War and were retired by 2005. Baseline facts: U.S. Cold War destroyer; 31 built; first gas-turbine destroyers; ASW optimized..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.
key_points: Spruance-class Destroyer: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history.

description: Comparison with contemporaries of the Spruance-class Destroyer: How the class compared with rival navies' ships. The Spruance class was the U.S. Navy's first gas-turbine destroyer: 31 built from 1975, optimized for anti-submarine warfare with quiet hulls and towed arrays. The large hull later parented the Ticonderoga cruisers. Spruances served through the Cold War and were retired by 2005. Baseline facts: U.S. Cold War destroyer; 31 built; first gas-turbine destroyers; ASW optimized..
how_it_works: Buoyancy supports the hull; propellers driven by diesel, turbine, or nuclear plant provide thrust; rudders and thrusters steer; stability comes from hull form and ballast.

U.S. Cold War destroyer; 31 built; first gas-turbine destroyers; ASW optimized.
